pin_title: 8 Christmas Stocking Fillers Under £15 UK Shoppers Rate Highly
pin_title_alt: 3 Cosy Little Extras to Make Christmas Stockings Feel Special
pin_hook: Small treats for the whole family, all well reviewed
pin_description: Christmas stocking filler ideas under £15 that UK shoppers rate highly: mini Christmas candles, novelty Christmas socks, Burt's Bees lip balm, rechargeable hand warmers, a Santa surprise bath bomb and more. Easy stocking stuffers for her, him, kids and teens. #ad #stockingfillers #christmasgifts #ukdeals
intro: Stockings are all about little treats that still feel thoughtful. Here are eight highly rated stocking fillers under £15, with something for everyone from kids and teens to the grown-ups.

products.name: Dsclavacy Christmas Scented Candles 12 Pack
products.headline: Twelve little festive candles to share out
products.why: A dozen small soy wax tin candles in Christmas scents, so one set can be split across several stockings. Travel tins make them easy to pop in anywhere.

products.name: 6 Pairs Christmas Novelty Design Socks
products.headline: The classic stocking filler, six times over
products.why: Christmas socks are a stocking tradition, and a six-pair pack means there's enough for everyone or a week of festive feet.

products.name: Burt's Bees Beeswax Bounty Lip Balm Gift Set
products.headline: A winter lip saver everyone actually uses
products.why: A set of Burt's Bees beeswax lip balms in vanilla bean and cucumber mint, one of the most reviewed lip care sets on Amazon UK. Handy for cold, windy days.

products.name: Gaiatop Rechargeable Hand Warmers 2 Pack (Avocado)
products.headline: Warm pockets on frosty mornings
products.why: Two cute avocado-shaped rechargeable hand warmers that clip together magnetically. A reusable alternative to single-use warmers for commuters and dog walkers.

products.name: ZIMPLI Large Santa Surprise Bath Bomb
products.headline: Bath time with a toy hidden inside
products.why: A big Santa bath bomb with a small collectable Christmas toy inside, which makes bath time on Christmas Eve a bit more exciting for little ones.

products.name: ECtury 12 Glitter Gel Pens
products.headline: Sparkly pens for doodlers and journallers
products.why: A colourful set of twelve glitter pens that tweens and teens love for journals, cards and colouring. Inexpensive and very well reviewed.

products.name: ZOOI 22-in-1 Ratchet Screwdriver
products.headline: A useful little tool for the DIY-er
products.why: A compact ratchet screwdriver with lots of interchangeable bits stored in the handle, a practical stocking filler for dads, grandads and anyone who fixes things.

products.name: e.l.f. Squeeze Me Lip Balm Duo
products.headline: A sheer tint teens will love
products.why: Two squeezy hyaluronic acid lip balms with a sheer wash of colour, a popular, affordable beauty treat for teens and makeup lovers.
